members.title: Washington DC shooting: suspect confirmed dead after one person is killed and four injured – latest updates
members.lead: Police say James Stuart, 46, was the manager of the building where suspect Matt Wade Lambert lived; the suspect had an ongoing dispute with the building’s owners Multiple people shot in Washington DC as police warn people to stay inside The incident is shifting from an active shooter response to a barricaded subject response, a federal law enforcement official has told NBC News. It is believed there is no other individual there at scene so this is not considered a hostage situation, they said, adding that it has been about 90 minutes since the suspect fired at law enforcement, which did not strike anyone. members.title: Police identify suspect and victim in Washington DC gym shooting that also injured four
members.lead: Authorities identify suspect as Matt Wade Lambert, 55, who died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound Washington DC shooting latest updates Four people were injured and one person died after a shooting in Northwest Washington DC on Thursday morning, local police said. In a Thursday afternoon press conference, law enforcement identified the suspect as 55-year-old Matt Wade Lambert, who died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound. Continue reading...
